findings.title: Service has no selector and no endpoints
findings.cause: Service payments has no selector, so Kubernetes keeps no endpoints for it, and it has no EndpointSlice: connections to it fail

evidence.command: kubectl get service payments -n kd-service-no-endpoints -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector}'

findings.fix: Give Service payments a selector that matches the pods it fronts, or create an EndpointSlice labelled kubernetes.io/service-name: payments with the addresses it should send to.
